description: Rank every Polymarket wallet with your own composite — exactly what the Ranking Builder runs (POST /v1/rankings/custom). weights: metric id → weight (or {weight, window}); any of the 84 catalog metrics at any window it exists at (polyrank_get_metric_windows), plus copy-engine (sk_score_14d) and entry-timing ids at lifetime. filters: min_trades, min_resolved, min_inband_n_30d (the in-band positions behind inband_return_30d: a sort by engine:inband_return_30d applies 10 unless you set it, 1 = every measured wallet; the floor that ran is in applied_filters), min_volume_usdc, min_realized_pnl(_net_fees), min_win_rate_pct, max_roi_pct, active_within_days/hours, categories, exclude_bonders, skill_gates [{metric,min_pctile,window}], metric_filters [{metric,min,max,window}], copy_engine {sleeve}, timing {sub,bucket,window,min_n}, cluster_policy, copy_placeable, smart_money_tags_any_of, follower_count_max … (the server rejects anything it cannot apply, with the reason). A HISTORY BOARD (a Strategy Lab history ranking's latest seat) is filters {history_board: {board}} with board one of underdog-specialists | copier-consensus | predictors-early-underdog | sports-closing-line and NO weights: it is ranked by the seat's own order and served as that preset board; only active_within_days, active_within_hours and best_category may narrow it (window_days, score, min_positions, one_per_operator and other keys are not accepted there), plus limit, offset, sort_by, sort_dir, include_breakdown, include_verdict, extra_metrics, extra_engine_metrics, dedupe_clusters. as_of=YYYY-MM-DD ranks the board as it stood that day (lifetime snapshot metrics only — refused with the reason otherwise, never answered live). To reproduce a Builder goal, pass its `request` from polyrank_list_ranking_templates as `request`. Needs POLYRANK_API_KEY (a plan with the Builder).

as_of.description: Rank the board as it stood on this day (ISO date). Lifetime snapshot metrics only.

dedupe_clusters.description: Keep one wallet per wallet-farm cluster.

explain.description: How many wallets each filter dropped.

include_raw.description: Raw values beside the percentiles (dollars, hours).

include_verdict.description: The copy verdict the trader page shows.

request.description: A complete POST /v1/rankings/custom body (e.g. a goal's `request`). When given, the other arguments override its fields.

sort_by.description: composite (default), metric:<id>, pctile:<id>, engine:<id>, timing:<id>, or a board column. engine:inband_return_30d is a mean over few positions for most wallets: it carries a min_inband_n_30d floor (default 10) and projects inband_n_30d beside it.

weights.description: metric id → weight, or → {weight, window}. Weights are auto-normalized.

window.description: Default window for every weight given as a bare number (default lifetime).

name: polyrank_rank_wallets
title: Polyrank Ranking Builder (custom composite ranking)
